name: Iver's Cell Key
description: An iron key on a loop of cord, worn bright where a thumb goes, cold now and silvered. Brother Iver Lusk carried it thirty-one years for one week each midsummer, the week he rowed in to Kindleby for oil. It holds Kindleby for him: the steps, the chapter at evening office, the Provost's tidy hand, the commas he argued, the way home. Burn it, and he'll not know there was anywhere else. A Remnant, made on purpose.
